city.body: Mayor Zohran Mamdani addressed rising incidents of racism targeting the Indian-American community during a Diwali celebration. He emphasized the need for collective responsibility in combating hate and ensuring safety for Hindus and Sikhs. city.body: Los Angeles City Council recognized Diwali and honored Consul General Dr KJ Srinivasa for his community contributions. The event featured cultural performances and was attended by various representatives from the Indian-American community. A resolution was passed to extend Diwali greetings to residents across Los Angeles. Both Dr Srinivasa and Mayor Nithya Raman committed to strengthening ties between India and Los Angeles.
